changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[GetIntersectNames] ( @id int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT SA.DisplayValue + ' / ' + OA.DisplayValue as Name FROM [Intersect] I left join AssetDetail SA on SA.Object = I.Subject and SA.ObjectID = I.SubjectID left join AssetDetail OA on OA.Object = I.Object and OA.ObjectID = I.ObjectID WHERE I.ID = @id )
